699f01f85f5f3c08.description: Job Purpose The Manager – Finance Operations will be embedded within the City Operations Finance & Control team, providing dedicated finance operations, contract and commercial support to the Workers accommodation team The role will manage the day-to-day invoice validation and processing, contract administration, commercial documentation and reporting for Workers Village contractors and service providers. Working closely with the Workers Village team, Finance & Control and suppliers, the role will ensure contractor charges are appropriately validated, supported, approved and processed through the Horizon system, with clear visibility of outstanding actions, risks and payments. As Workers Village activity and contractor volumes grow, the role will provide the dedicated commercial and financial control needed to support effective operations. Key Responsibilities Manage contractor invoicing end-to-end, from receipt and validation through approval, Horizon processing and payment tracking. Validate invoices against contractual terms and supporting operational data, including contractor man-days, agreed rates and relevant service information. Lead invoice processing through the Horizon system, ensuring submissions are complete, accurate and supported by the required documentation and approvals. Manage invoice queries and discrepancies, working directly with contractors, vendors, Workers Village and Finance teams to drive timely resolution. Support contract administration, including preparation and review of contracts, RoUs, supporting schedules and other commercial documentation. Coordinate commercial and financial approvals, ensuring the appropriate justification, documentation and governance requirements are in place. Maintain clear contract, invoice and payment trackers, proactively following up outstanding actions and escalating material issues. Provide regular management reporting on invoice volumes, payment status, ageing, contract status, risks and key actions. Act as a key coordination point between Workers Village, Finance & Control, wider internal functions, contractors and vendors on invoicing and contract matters. Maintain robust financial controls and audit trails, ensuring contract and payment documentation is complete and readily available. Support the Senior Manager and Directors with commercial analysis, contract matters, reporting and ad-hoc requirements relating to Workers Village operations. Help improve and standardize invoicing, contract administration and reporting processes as Workers Village operations continue to scale. Experience 8+ years' relevant experience across finance operations, commercial management, contract administration, invoicing or related roles. Strong experience managing contractor invoicing, validation, approvals and payment processes, ideally in a high-volume operational environment. Experience supporting large operational/service contracts, preferably within workforce accommodation, FM, O&M, hospitality, infrastructure or similar environments. Good understanding of contracts and commercial terms, with the ability to validate supplier charges against contractual rates, supporting documentation and operational data. Experience dealing with volume-based or activity-based billing, such as man-days, headcount, unit rates, service volumes or similar charging mechanisms. Strong reporting and analytical capability, including maintaining invoice/payment trackers, reconciliations, ageing analysis and management reporting. Experience with ERP/procure-to-pay systems, ideally Horizon, PRISM, Ariba or equivalent, together with strong Excel skills. Strong attention to detail and a controls-focused mindset, with the ability to identify discrepancies and resolve issues proactively. Experience within Saudi Arabia/GCC and complex operational environments would be advantageous. Qualifications Bachelor’s degree in finance, Accounting, Business, Commercial Management, Contract Management or a related discipline. Relevant Finance, Commercial, Procurement or Contract Management professional qualification would be advantageous.

69bb70606cbb9d74.description: نبذة عن الدور تبحث شركة سمامة للتشغيل والإدارة عن فني هندسة كهربائية للانضمام إلى فريقها في جدة، مكة المكرمة. يركز هذا الدور بدوام كامل على تركيب وصيانة الأنظمة الكهربائية، وتقديم الدعم الفني للمهندسين. المسؤوليات الرئيسية تركيب المحركات واللوحات والمولدات والمحولات الكهربائية، والإشراف عليها ومراقبتها. تقديم المساعدة للمهندسين الكهربائيين في حل المشكلات الفنية. تحديد المخطط، وتقدير كمية المواد والمعدات واليد العاملة المطلوبة بناءً على المخططات الأولية. توجيه وتنسيق جهود العمال والفنيين والحرفيين الآخرين المتعلقة بأعمال التركيب الكهربائي. اختبار الأنظمة بعد تركيبها لضمان التقيد بالمخطط الأولي والمواصفات المطلوبة. القيام بعمليات الفحص الروتينية ضمن أعمال الصيانة الوقائية، وتشخيص الأعطال والتلف المحتمل، واتخاذ الإجراءات التصحيحية. التحقق من الأعطال وفحص الأجزاء والمعدات المعطوبة، وتشخيص المكونات التالفة وإصلاحها أو استبدالها. ضمان الاستجابة السريعة لعمليات الطوارئ للتقليل من فترات انقطاع التيار الكهربائي. المؤهلات والخبرات خبرة تتراوح بين 5 إلى 10 سنوات في مجال الهندسة الكهربائية أو مجال ذي صلة. فهم قوي لمبادئ التركيب والصيانة الكهربائية. القدرة على قراءة وتفسير المخططات والمواصفات الفنية. المهارات المطلوبة مهارات ممتازة في تشخيص الأعطال وإصلاحها. القدرة على العمل بفعالية ضمن فريق. مهارات تواصل جيدة لتقديم المساعدة للمهندسين وتوجيه العمال. الالتزام بمعايير السلامة والجودة. بيئة العمل هذا الدور بدوام كامل في مدينة جدة، مكة المكرمة، ضمن فريق متخصص في شركة سمامة للتشغيل والإدارة. معلومات إضافية الراتب لهذا المنصب سيتم تحديده بناءً على الخبرة والمؤهلات، ولن يتم الإفصاح عنه في هذه المرحلة.

692d7cd06b4e4f02.description: About AECOM AECOM is a global leader in infrastructure consulting, dedicated to delivering a better world through innovative solutions. As a trusted professional services firm, AECOM addresses complex challenges in water, environment, energy, transportation, and buildings. The company partners with public and private sector clients to create sustainable and resilient solutions throughout the project lifecycle. AECOM is a Fortune 500 firm, with operations in Jeddah, Saudi Arabia. Role Overview AECOM is seeking a highly experienced Quantity Surveyor to join its team in Jeddah. This full-time role requires over 10 years of relevant experience in quantity surveying, cost management, commercial management, estimation, tendering, or construction. Preference will be given to candidates with experience in Operations and Maintenance (O&M) projects. The Quantity Surveyor will manage various aspects of cost and commercial operations across projects, ensuring compliance and supporting project delivery. Key Responsibilities Manage quantity surveying, cost management, commercial management, and estimation activities across projects. Prepare and review Bills of Quantities (BOQs), cost estimates, budgets, tender documents, and commercial proposals. Develop cost plans, monitor project expenditure, and identify cost-saving opportunities. Manage tendering activities, including pricing, bid evaluation, and commercial submissions. Review contracts, variations, claims, payment applications, and final accounts. Conduct cost analysis, financial forecasting, and budget monitoring to support project delivery. Support Operations and Maintenance (O&M) projects through cost estimation, tender preparation, pricing, and commercial management of maintenance contracts. Review technical and commercial information, verify the accuracy of project data, and prepare detailed cost reports. Coordinate with engineering, procurement, operations, and project management teams to ensure cost and commercial requirements are met. Handle complex commercial and cost-related problems and provide recommendations based on professional expertise. Work independently under general direction and take responsibility for assigned tasks and deliverables. Ensure compliance with contractual requirements, project standards, and relevant commercial procedures. Qualifications and Experience A minimum of 10 years of relevant experience in quantity surveying, cost management, commercial management, estimation, tendering, or construction. An engineering degree is required. Strong background in cost planning, cost control, contract administration, tender preparation, and commercial operations. Professional accreditation such as MRICS or RICS is preferred. Experience in Operations and Maintenance (O&M) projects is preferred. Work Environment This role is based in Jeddah and operates on a full-time basis. The successful candidate will join a global team working on infrastructure projects, collaborating with diverse teams across engineering, procurement, operations, and project management.

69415805daa21286.description: About the Role FNRCO is seeking an Associate Manager for Delivery Governance & Management Oversight. This full-time position is based in Jeddah, Makkah, Saudi Arabia. The role focuses on providing management oversight across various teams and engagements, with an emphasis on governance, performance oversight, and ensuring alignment with organizational standards, rather than direct operational project management. Role Context and Objectives The Associate Manager will be responsible for reviewing delivery performance and monitoring high-level progress against established objectives and Service Level Agreements (SLAs). A key aspect of this role involves ensuring that potential risks, issues, and escalations are promptly identified and addressed through the appropriate delivery management channels to maintain operational efficiency and compliance. Key Responsibilities Provide oversight of people and stakeholders, including monitoring team utilization, workload balance, capability development, and performance feedback. Support the maintenance of a healthy and sustainable operating model within the organization. Act as a senior interface between delivery teams, the Delivery Manager, and leadership, ensuring clear communication, transparency, and alignment of expectations. Support governance forums, reporting mechanisms, audit readiness initiatives, and continuous improvement efforts. Ensure the consistent application of organizational policies, controls, and quality standards across all engagements. Qualifications and Experience 5-7 years of relevant experience in a similar capacity. Demonstrated experience in governance and performance oversight across multiple teams and engagements. Understanding of delivery performance monitoring, objectives, and Service Level Agreements (SLAs). Ability to identify, monitor, and manage risks, issues, and escalations effectively. Experience in stakeholder coordination and communication with delivery teams and leadership. Familiarity with team utilization, workload balance, and capability development strategies. Experience supporting governance forums, reporting, and audit readiness activities. Familiarity with organizational policies, controls, and quality standards. Work Environment This is a full-time position within FNRCO, located in Jeddah, Makkah, Saudi Arabia. The role involves working closely with various delivery teams, management, and leadership to ensure robust governance and effective oversight.

6964382cb58f460e.description: About the Role Eram Talent is seeking a Business Systems & Reporting Analyst for a full-time position with their esteemed client in Dhahran, Saudi Arabia. This role is central to supporting data-driven decision-making by processing, analyzing, and interpreting large-scale data records. The analyst will operate at the intersection of Management Information Systems (MIS) and business operations, with a preference for experience within the Learning & Development (L&D) domain. Role Purpose The primary purpose of this position is to synthesize complex information into actionable insights, executive presentations, and structured reports. The successful candidate will be instrumental in evaluating program performance, training metrics, and operational deliverables, particularly within Learning & Development or HR business units. Key Responsibilities Extract, clean, compile, and analyze large datasets using MS Excel, PDF Professional, and corporate reporting tools. Interpret complex data records, identify operational trends, draw meaningful conclusions, and present data-backed recommendations to management. Design, build, and maintain scheduled and ad-hoc reporting dashboards and presentations using MS PowerPoint and MS Excel. Collaborate with business units, specifically Learning & Development and HR, to evaluate program performance, training metrics, and operational deliverables. Evaluate existing reporting workflows and systems to identify gaps, streamline data collection, and enhance reporting accuracy. Collaborate effectively with internal teams and stakeholders to communicate analytical findings clearly and support ongoing business projects. Qualifications and Experience Bachelor’s Degree in Management Information Systems (MIS) or a closely related field from a reputable university. Minimum of 3 years of hands-on experience in data analysis, data processing, and business reporting. Prior work experience within the Learning & Development (L&D) or HR domain is strongly preferred. Advanced proficiency in MS Excel, including data manipulation, formulas, pivot tables, and modeling. Demonstrated experience with PDF Professional tools for document processing and reporting. Required Skills Strong analytical thinking with a proven track record of converting raw data into meaningful executive insights. Excellent verbal and written English communication skills. Strong interpersonal, team collaboration, and presentation abilities. Application Information This full-time position requires 2-5 years of relevant experience. Salary details will be discussed during the interview process.

69cad9f91e223eb1.description: About the Role Luxoft is seeking a Murex Production Support Consultant with a focus on Market Risk and End-of-Day (EOD) activities. This full-time role is based in Riyadh and involves providing technical production support for a large bank in Saudi Arabia, specifically addressing environment EOD and market risk operations. Key Responsibilities Troubleshoot and resolve daily production issues related to Market Risk calculations, including Value at Risk (VaR), stress testing, and P&L attribution frameworks. Manage Market Risk related vendor deliveries, support, and issue closure. Support Murex Risk Architecture (MRA) and Murex Risk Engine (MRE) to ensure accurate generation of VaR, stress testing, and sensitivities (Delta, Gamma, Vega). Provide front-line support, triage production issues, perform root cause analysis, and remediate risk calculation or workflow failures. Offer Level 2 Support for all EOD issues and ensure recurring problems are addressed through problem management. Execute EOD processes, create and test jobs and flows, and troubleshoot failures during EOD, including user/trader issues, system failures, and infrastructure problems. Resolve EOD issues such as DataMart feeder failures, market data failures, slow or crashing user sessions, and accounting EOD failures, escalating to infrastructure teams as needed. Coordinate with vendors for reported bugs, track fixes, deploy re-tests, and ensure quality in technical deployments. Liaise for diagnostics and troubleshooting of EOD issues. Perform sanity checks within the Murex UI, covering workflows and real-time data. Handle ad hoc operational requests, including generating on-demand reports, file transfers, and housekeeping activities. Qualifications and Experience 8 to 12 years of total experience, with Murex Production Support experience being mandatory. Good domain knowledge and in-depth understanding of the trade life cycle across various asset classes, including Forex, Derivatives, Fixed Income, and Money Market. 5-10 years of experience in Murex market risk management and 3-5 years of experience with the Murex Environment. Demonstrated Murex Market Risk experience, including VaR, SIMM, and FRTB. Proficiency with Murex EOD architecture, key services, and end-to-end processes. Knowledge of scheduling tools such as Control-M or Autosys. Understanding of database fundamentals, including query plans, SQL, and indexing. Preferred Skills Experience with Datamart Dynamic tables/Feeders/batch Configuration, scanner templates, and processing script definition. Work Environment This is a full-time technical production support role within a large banking environment, requiring a focus on market risk and EOD activities. The position is based in Riyadh. Application Process Candidates meeting the specified requirements are encouraged to apply.

694f96830615e4e8.description: نبذة عن الوظيفة تبحث شركة رحال الاولي للنقل البري عن سائق شاحنة صغيرة للانضمام إلى فريقها في مكة المكرمة. يهدف هذا الدور إلى ضمان التشغيل الفعال والآمن للشاحنة، والالتزام بالمسارات المحددة ومعايير السلامة. يتطلب الدور خبرة تتراوح بين سنتين وخمس سنوات في مجال القيادة. المسؤوليات الرئيسية تشغيل وقيادة الشاحنة الصغيرة وفقًا للمسارات وخطط العمل الموضوعة. الالتزام التام بقواعد المرور وأنظمة الأمن والسلامة، وتجنب ارتكاب أي مخالفات نظامية. إجراء فحوصات دورية ومنتظمة على الشاحنة للتحقق من سلامتها وكفاءتها. معالجة المشكلات والأعطال البسيطة التي قد تطرأ على الشاحنة بشكل فوري. رفع طلبات الصيانة اللازمة عند ملاحظة أي خلل يتطلب تدخل الخبراء أو الفنيين المتخصصين. الالتزام بكافة أدلة الإجراءات، أدلة المواصفات والمعايير، وسياسات وقواعد السلامة العامة المعتمدة في الشركة. المؤهلات والخبرات المطلوبة خبرة عملية تتراوح بين سنتين وخمس سنوات كسائق شاحنة صغيرة أو في دور مماثل. معرفة جيدة بقواعد المرور وأنظمة السلامة على الطرق. القدرة على إجراء الفحوصات الأساسية للشاحنة وتحديد المشكلات البسيطة. الالتزام بالتعليمات والإجراءات التشغيلية. بيئة العمل هذه الوظيفة بدوام كامل ومقرها في مكة المكرمة. سيعمل السائق ضمن فريق شركة رحال الاولي للنقل البري، ملتزماً بالمعايير المهنية المحددة لضمان سير العمليات بسلاسة وكفاءة. معلومات إضافية الراتب لهذه الوظيفة غير معلن وسيتم تحديده بناءً على الخبرة والمؤهلات خلال عملية التوظيف.

698c962846a962b1.description: About PetroApp PetroApp manages fuel payments and fleet control solutions for businesses across Saudi Arabia, Egypt, Nigeria, and Thailand. The platform enables drivers to pay with NFC at partner stations, provides fleet managers with real-time transaction visibility and limit-setting capabilities, and incorporates fraud checks to prevent unauthorized transactions. PetroApp is expanding its offerings beyond fuel to include vehicle services, a consumer application for car owners, and additional tools for partner stations. The Role of Senior Product Manager PetroApp is seeking a Senior Product Manager to join its team in Riyadh, Saudi Arabia. This full-time role involves taking ownership of a specific product area, focusing on its strategic direction and measurable outcomes rather than solely managing a backlog. The Senior Product Manager will be responsible for identifying valuable product initiatives, developing business cases, and overseeing their successful delivery. The assigned product area will be determined based on the candidate's strengths and current company priorities. Key Responsibilities Define the vision, strategy, and roadmap for the assigned product area, ensuring alignment with company OKRs and measurable outcomes. Make informed decisions on what not to build, providing clear justifications and maintaining a focused roadmap on high-impact initiatives. Lead discovery efforts with fleet customers, drivers, station partners, and car owners to validate demand before committing engineering resources. Translate strategic objectives into clear Product Requirements Documents (PRDs), user stories, and acceptance criteria, and remain engaged through the delivery process until launch. Lead cross-functional collaboration with Engineering, Design, Operations, Sales, Marketing, Finance, and Compliance teams. Manage delivery speed for the product area, aiming to shorten the idea-to-release cycle while maintaining quality standards. Establish success metrics and guardrails upfront, measure results post-launch, and take action based on data insights. Design solutions that address complex aspects of the business, including payments and wallet flows, fraud detection, regulatory requirements, and multi-country product operations. Identify opportunities in partnerships, new services, and competitor activities, and develop corresponding business cases. Mentor other Product Managers and contribute to elevating team standards in product documentation, prioritization, and delivery. Required Qualifications and Experience 2-5 years of experience in product management. Demonstrated ability to own product direction and results. Experience in setting product vision, strategy, and roadmaps. Proficiency in leading discovery, validating demand, and translating strategy into detailed product specifications. Strong background in cross-functional team leadership and project delivery. Familiarity with designing products for complex business environments, including payments, fraud, and regulatory compliance. Work Type and Location This is a full-time position based in Riyadh, Saudi Arabia. The role requires an individual who can operate effectively within a dynamic environment, contributing to the development of products that serve diverse markets.

69a40acf0bad56ab.description: نبذة عن الدور تبحث شركة الدكتور سليمان عبدالقادر فق عن أخصائي تمريض للانضمام إلى فريقها في جدة، مكة المكرمة. يهدف هذا الدور بدوام كامل إلى تقديم رعاية تمريضية متكاملة للمرضى، مع التركيز على التقييم والتخطيط والتنفيذ والمتابعة. يتطلب الدور خبرة تتراوح بين سنتين وخمس سنوات في مجال التمريض. المهام والمسؤوليات الرئيسية تقييم الوضع الصحي للمريض، وجمع البيانات من المريض وذويه، وتوثيقها وتحليلها لتحديد احتياجات الرعاية. إعداد خطة الرعاية التمريضية ومتابعة تنفيذها وتقييم نتائجها بشكل دوري. أخذ العلامات الحيوية للمريض وعينات الدم والبول والبراز لإجراء الفحوصات المخبرية وفقاً لتعليمات الطبيب المعالج، ومتابعة إرسالها للمختبر والحصول على النتائج وإعلام الطبيب. إعطاء الأدوية والعقاقير الطبية والمحاليل الوريدية حسب تعليمات الطبيب المعالج. المشاركة الفعالة في عملية الإنعاش القلبي والرئوي عند الحاجة. تطوير أساليب وإجراءات العمل ومواكبة التطورات الحديثة في أساليب التمريض والرعاية التمريضية. توثيق جميع الإجراءات والأنشطة التمريضية المقدمة للمريض في السجل الطبي. ضمان تطبيق مبادئ وقواعد السلامة العامة أثناء القيام بمختلف أعمال وعمليات التمريض. المؤهلات والخبرات المطلوبة خبرة عملية تتراوح بين سنتين إلى خمس سنوات في مجال التمريض. القدرة على تقييم الحالات الصحية بدقة وتحديد احتياجات الرعاية. مهارات ممتازة في التواصل والتعامل مع المرضى وذويهم. المهارات والكفاءات القدرة على العمل ضمن فريق متعدد التخصصات. الالتزام بمعايير السلامة والجودة في الرعاية الصحية. مهارات تنظيمية وتوثيقية قوية. القدرة على التكيف مع التطورات المهنية المستمرة. بيئة العمل هذه الوظيفة بدوام كامل في مدينة جدة، مكة المكرمة، ضمن بيئة عمل داعمة تركز على تقديم أفضل مستويات الرعاية الصحية. التقديم ندعو المهتمين الذين يستوفون المتطلبات المذكورة أعلاه إلى تقديم طلباتهم.

6910ff1e0c391ceb.description: نبذة عن الدور تبحث شركة المصنع السعودي اللبناني للمفروشات والاعمال الخشبية عن موظف استقبال للانضمام إلى فريقها في الرياض. هذا الدور بدوام كامل ويتطلب خبرة تتراوح بين 0-1 سنة، ويهدف إلى ضمان تقديم تجربة استقبال احترافية للزوار والعملاء، بالإضافة إلى إدارة الاتصالات الهاتفية والداخلية بكفاءة. المهام والمسؤوليات الرئيسية استقبال الزوار والعملاء والترحيب بهم، وتحديد متطلباتهم، وتزويدهم بالمعلومات اللازمة. إبلاغ المرجع المعني بوصول المراجعين والعملاء وإرشادهم إليه. استقبال المكالمات الهاتفية والرد على الاستفسارات أو تحويلها إلى القسم المختص. إجراء الاتصالات الداخلية للحصول على المعلومات المطلوبة. ترتيب مواعيد المقابلات وتسجيل أسماء المراجعين والعملاء في السجلات المخصصة لذلك. الالتزام التام بالأدلة الإجرائية والسياسات والإجراءات التنظيمية المعتمدة والتقيد بها. المؤهلات والخبرات خبرة عملية تتراوح بين 0 إلى 1 سنة في مجال ذي صلة. القدرة على التعامل مع الزوار والعملاء بأسلوب احترافي وودود. مهارات اتصال ممتازة شفهية وكتابية. بيئة العمل يقع مقر العمل في مدينة الرياض، المملكة العربية السعودية. الوظيفة بدوام كامل وتتطلب التواجد في مقر الشركة لتقديم الدعم اللازم لعمليات الاستقبال والاتصالات. طبيعة العمل يتطلب هذا الدور الالتزام بالسياسات والإجراءات الداخلية للشركة، والعمل ضمن فريق لضمان سير العمليات اليومية بسلاسة وكفاءة. الراتب سيتم تحديده بناءً على الخبرة والمؤهلات. التقديم للمهتمين بالانضمام إلى فريق شركة المصنع السعودي اللبناني للمفروشات والاعمال الخشبية، يرجى تقديم طلباتكم عبر القنوات المتاحة.

6986698b0818f203.description: نبذة عن الدور تبحث فرع شركة عبدالعالي العجمي عن مهندس مدني للانضمام إلى فريقها في الرياض، المزاحمية. يركز هذا الدور بدوام كامل على الإشراف الهندسي وإعداد التصاميم والمخططات الإنشائية، بالإضافة إلى متابعة تنفيذ المشاريع لضمان مطابقتها للمواصفات الفنية. يتطلب الدور خبرة تتراوح بين 0-1 سنة. المهام والمسؤوليات الرئيسية دراسة طبوغرافية وجيولوجية الموقع الإنشائي وتحليل نتائج اختبار فحص التربة. دراسة المتطلبات والمخططات المعمارية الخاصة بالمشروع. تحديد أعماق التأسيس اللازمة للمشروع وإجراء تحليل إنشائي متكامل لعناصره. إعداد التصاميم الإنشائية ومتابعة إعداد المخططات الإنشائية وتدقيقها. تدقيق جداول الكميات والمواصفات للمواد الإنشائية. الإشراف المباشر على تنفيذ المشروع ومطابقة المواصفات الفنية. تطوير أساليب وإجراءات العمل ومواكبة التطورات التقنية في المجال الهندسي. إعداد الوثائق والتقارير المتخصصة بنتائج الأعمال والمشروعات الهندسية، وتوضيح نسبة تقدمها وحفظها في قاعدة البيانات المعتمدة. المؤهلات والخبرة شهادة جامعية في الهندسة المدنية. خبرة عملية تتراوح بين 0 إلى 1 سنة في مجال الهندسة المدنية أو ما يعادلها. المهارات المطلوبة القدرة على تحليل البيانات الطبوغرافية والجيولوجية. مهارات قوية في إعداد التصاميم والمخططات الإنشائية. القدرة على الإشراف على المشاريع وضمان الجودة. مهارات إعداد التقارير الفنية والتوثيق. بيئة العمل يعمل المهندس المدني ضمن فريق عمل في فرع شركة عبدالعالي العجمي، ويقع مقر العمل في المزاحمية، الرياض. الوظيفة بدوام كامل وتتطلب التواجد في الموقع حسب متطلبات المشروع. التقديم للمهتمين بالانضمام إلى فريق عملنا، يرجى تقديم طلباتكم عبر القنوات المتاحة.

69f8c4525a554645.description: نبذة عن الدور تبحث مطاعم النور الشامي عن مدير مطعم للانضمام إلى فريقها في المدينة المنورة. يتولى مدير المطعم مسؤولية تخطيط وتوجيه وتنسيق جميع العمليات اليومية للمطعم، بما في ذلك إدارة المرافق والخدمات وعمليات الشراء. هذا الدور بدوام كامل ويتطلب خبرة تتراوح من 0 إلى 1 سنة. المهام والمسؤوليات الرئيسية إدارة عملية تخطيط وتقديم الأطعمة والمشروبات والخدمات الأخرى لضمان جودة الأداء. مراقبة استهلاك واستخدام الأطعمة والمشروبات والإمدادات الأخرى، وإدارة عملية اختيار الموردين وتقديم الطلبات. الإشراف على مرافق المطعم والمطبخ، وضمان النظافة والصيانة الدورية. إدارة إنتاج المنتجات الجديدة والخدمات المقدمة وتسليمها بفعالية. وضع السياسات والإجراءات اللازمة لضمان الالتزام بلوائح الصحة والسلامة العامة، والإشراف على تنفيذها. المؤهلات والخبرات خبرة عملية تتراوح من 0 إلى 1 سنة في مجال إدارة المطاعم أو ما يعادلها. القدرة على تخطيط وتوجيه وتنسيق العمليات التشغيلية للمطعم. فهم جيد لإدارة المخزون وعمليات الشراء. المهارات المطلوبة مهارات قيادية وإدارية قوية. القدرة على اتخاذ القرارات وحل المشكلات بفعالية. مهارات تواصل ممتازة مع الموظفين والموردين. الالتزام بمعايير الصحة والسلامة والنظافة. بيئة العمل يعمل مدير المطعم بدوام كامل في المدينة المنورة ضمن فريق مطاعم النور الشامي. يتطلب الدور التواجد في الموقع للإشراف المباشر على العمليات وضمان سيرها بسلاسة. معلومات إضافية الراتب لهذا الدور غير معلن وسيتم تحديده بناءً على الخبرة والمؤهلات. هذه فرصة للانضمام إلى فريق متخصص في قطاع الضيافة بالمدينة المنورة.

691636685fe71fd5.description: Job Summary Lead the Environmental Management function for City Operations, establishing and maintaining the governance, standards, assurance and compliance framework needed to manage environmental risks across city assets, public spaces, activities and operations. Ensure environmental permits, monitoring, reporting and corrective actions meet applicable regulatory requirements, while embedding environmental performance, resource efficiency, biodiversity and sustainable operational practices into day-to-day City Operations. Key Responsibilities Core Responsibilities • Lead the City Operations environmental management function and translate environmental strategy, regulatory obligations and corporate requirements into operational plans, standards and controls. • Establish the environmental governance and assurance framework for City Operations, including compliance obligations, performance monitoring, inspections, audits, reporting and corrective-action tracking. • Ensure required environmental permits and approvals are identified, maintained and complied with for City Operations assets, activities and operations. • Oversee environmental monitoring and compliance across city assets and public spaces, including emissions, waste, discharge, water use, landscaping, vegetation, biodiversity and habitat protection requirements. • Maintain effective engagement with the Ministry of Environment, Water & Agriculture and the National Center for Environmental Compliance (NCEC), including regulatory submissions, monitoring reports and corrective action plans. • Provide environmental advice during asset readiness, handover, operational change, events and new activities to ensure environmental requirements are considered before operation. • Lead investigation and remediation of environmental non-compliances, incidents and emerging risks, driving timely corrective and preventive actions. • Define environmental KPIs and leading indicators, analyze performance trends and provide clear management reporting and escalation of material risks. • Coordinate with Health & Safety, Worker Welfare, Asset Management, Infrastructure, Community Management, CCU, Operations, Risk, Procurement and service providers to embed environmental controls into operational delivery. • Build environmental capability across City Operations through awareness, guidance, training and contractor/service-provider requirements. Specific Responsibilities • Develop and maintain the City Operations Environmental Management Plan and supporting procedures, registers and compliance obligations. • Maintain an environmental aspects and impacts register and support integration of material environmental risks into City Operations risk management. • Establish inspection and audit programs for operations and service providers, with risk-based follow-up and closure verification. • Ensure environmental requirements are appropriately incorporated into scopes, contracts, procurement evaluations and service-provider performance reviews. • Coordinate environmental input to emergency preparedness and business resilience where environmental impacts may arise from incidents. • Support operational sustainability initiatives focused on waste minimization, pollution prevention, water efficiency, resource conservation and protection of the public realm. Generic Responsibilities • Contribute to annual business planning, workforce planning and budget management for the function. • Lead, coach and develop the environmental team and technical service providers. • Promote a culture of accountability, prevention, continual improvement and evidence-based decision-making. • Maintain accurate records and provide timely reports, presentations and recommendations to City Operations leadership. • Perform other related duties consistent with the role and business requirements. Key internal interactions • City Operations leadership and functional directors • HSE & Workers Welfare • City Assets Management and Infrastructure Assets Management • Operations, CCU and Operational Resilience • Governance, Risk & Controls • Contracts & Procurement • Finance & Controls • City Community Management and relevant project/handover teams Key External Interactions • Ministry of Environment, Water & Agriculture (MEWA) • National Center for Environmental Compliance (NCEC) • Relevant government and regulatory authorities • Environmental consultants, laboratories and specialist advisors • Operations, maintenance and service-provider contractors • Developers, delivery partners and other external stakeholders as required Minimum Qualifications • Bachelor’s degree in environmental science, Environmental Engineering, Environmental Management, Sustainability, Engineering or a closely related discipline. • Master’s degree in a relevant field is desirable Professional Certifications • Recognized environmental management / auditing qualification is desirable, such as ISO 14001 Lead Auditor or Lead Implementer. • Professional membership or certification with a recognized environmental body is desirable Skills • Strong knowledge of environmental management systems, compliance assurance, permitting, monitoring and regulator engagement. • Knowledge of environmental aspects and impacts, pollution prevention, waste, water, emissions, biodiversity and environmental incident management. • Strong leadership, stakeholder management, analytical, risk-management and decision-making skills. • Strong written and verbal communication, with the ability to present technical issues clearly to senior leadership and external authorities. • Ability to manage consultants, contractors and multidisciplinary interfaces in a complex city or large-asset operational environment.

694ed2d68ed56ef4.description: About the Program King Salman International Airport is offering a 12-month Graduate Development Program (GDP) in Riyadh, Saudi Arabia. This full-time program is designed to prepare Saudi graduates for careers within the aviation and airport development sector. The program aims to integrate participants into the airport's operational and developmental initiatives. Program Structure and Content The Graduate Development Program includes a structured learning journey and practical application components. Participants will engage in various activities designed to build professional skills and provide exposure to the aviation industry. An onboarding bootcamp focused on introducing the KSIA WAY. An extensive learning journey with modules dedicated to developing essential professional skills. Mentoring support throughout the program. Completion of a capstone project. Quarterly evaluations to assess progress. A graduation ceremony upon successful completion of the program. Career Opportunities The program offers 20 graduate opportunities across diverse fields within King Salman International Airport. Participants will contribute to shaping the future of aviation and airport development. This role requires 0-1 years of experience. Program Benefits Participants in the Graduate Development Program will receive employment benefits and structured professional development from the start of the program. Employment with King Salman International Airport from the first day. Salary and benefits provided in line with company policy. Structured professional learning and on-the-job development. Opportunities for career growth within the organization.

695298aa03891b62.description: About Siemens Smart Infrastructure Siemens is committed to a Digital Portfolio, integrating Digital Power Distribution and Digital Building Infrastructure technologies within its Smart Infrastructure Electrification and Automation division. This approach aims to provide intuitive, comfortable, safe, secure, and energy-efficient buildings for customers. Siemens Smart Infrastructure connects energy systems, buildings, and industries to support sustainable development and resource optimization. The Role of Testing and Commissioning Engineer Siemens is seeking a Testing and Commissioning Engineer (Substation Automation System) to join the Smart Infrastructure Electrification and Automation division in Jeddah. This full-time role requires 5-10 years of experience and involves contributing to the development of smarter infrastructure solutions. Key Responsibilities Design and parameterize Substation Control and Monitoring Systems, including Human Machine Interface (HMI) / SCADA. Parameterize BCU and Protection digital relays for Medium and High Voltage IEDs. Commission Substation Control and Monitoring Systems, including conducting functional performance, Factory Acceptance Tests (FAT), and Site Acceptance Tests (SAT) with witnesses. Prepare technical reports and documentation of results, including panel drawings, test protocols, and SCADA Point list/Module data checklists. Report project progress to technical project management. Adhere to Environmental, Health, and Safety (EHS) guidelines. Stay updated with end-user technical standards and regulations. Work collaboratively within a team environment and share knowledge. Travel across the Kingdom of Saudi Arabia to participate in commissioning activities. Implement cybersecurity measures in automation systems. Required Qualifications and Experience A minimum of 5-10 years of experience in a relevant field. Ability to travel extensively throughout the Kingdom for commissioning activities. Localization Commitment Localization is a strategic priority for Siemens and is central to its growth plans in the Kingdom of Saudi Arabia, aligning with Vision 2030. Qualified Saudi national engineering professionals meeting the specified qualifications are encouraged to apply. Siemens is dedicated to developing local talent and building long-term engineering capabilities within the Kingdom.

6992bd80037d5ea1.description: About Jazeera Paints Jazeera Paints is seeking a Showroom Sales Representative to join their team in Riyadh. This full-time role focuses on implementing sales plans and ensuring a high standard of customer service within the showroom environment. Role Purpose The primary purpose of this role is to execute the showroom sales plan effectively to achieve assigned sales targets. The representative will manage daily showroom operations, customer interactions, and inventory to ensure compliance with company policies and procedures. Key Responsibilities Welcome customers, provide high-standard service, and address their needs. Manage product handovers and offer pre-sales and after-sales support. Oversee showroom operations and inventory, ensuring adherence to Jazeera Paints policies. Guide customers through product introductions, requirement identification, quantity determination, color coordination, and product selection. Ensure accurate order processing, invoicing, and product delivery. Coordinate showroom personnel activities, including assistants, laborers, and drivers, for efficient operations. Maintain showroom cleanliness, organization, and overall presentation. Ensure the availability of marketing materials such as brochures, leaflets, and product catalogs. Achieve assigned sales targets in line with the approved sales plan and implement management objectives and KPIs. Process customer orders via online channels, update the e-commerce platform, and ensure accurate reflection of products and inventory. Ensure adequate stock availability across all product categories, especially fast-moving items, and apply stock replenishment procedures from warehouses based on established minimum and maximum levels. Comply with the First-In, First-Out (FIFO) principle to minimize slow-moving and obsolete inventory. Report missing or unavailable products at the central warehouse and any showroom damage, equipment malfunctions, or maintenance requirements to the direct manager, following up on corrective actions. Conduct inventory counts, reconcile physical balances, and report shortages, damage, or loss. Complete daily closing processes accurately and on time, including handling and recording customer advance payments. Execute assigned marketing programs and initiatives, including product campaigns and field visits to residential development areas. Maintain the showroom's appearance and ensure all employees comply with uniform and dress code requirements. Promote and sell all company product ranges to achieve sales targets and maximize opportunities. Ensure the availability and proper condition of safety equipment, reporting non-compliance, including valid Civil Defense and municipal licenses, fire extinguishers, and company vehicle roadworthiness and documentation. Ensure implementation and compliance with the company's Ashanak program terms and conditions. Comply with company policies, procedures, and established guidelines, executing activities using safe and environmental methods. Perform any other duties assigned by the direct supervisor or manager. Work Type This is a full-time position based in Riyadh.

690971e2c8bcd89e.description: About AECOM AECOM is a global infrastructure consulting firm dedicated to delivering a better world through various projects, including improving commutes, ensuring power supply, providing access to clean water, and transforming skylines. With over 50,000 professionals worldwide, AECOM partners with clients to address complex challenges and build legacies for future generations. The company is committed to creating a positive and tangible impact globally. The Role: Senior Electrical Engineering AECOM is seeking a Senior Electrical Engineering professional to join its team in Riyadh. This full-time role requires over 12 years of experience and involves supervising and overseeing all electrical installation works on complex fit-out projects. The successful candidate will ensure compliance with design intent, project specifications, and applicable codes, contributing to the delivery of high-quality infrastructure solutions. Key Responsibilities Supervise and oversee all electrical installation works on complex fit-out projects, ensuring compliance with design intent and project specifications. Lead the technical review of contractor shop drawings, material submittals, method statements, RFIs, technical proposals, and calculations against IFC drawings and applicable codes. Provide on-site supervision and support for inspections, testing, commissioning, and handover activities, maintaining quality standards throughout the fit-out process. Review and approve LV systems design and installation, including power distribution, lighting, emergency lighting, small power, DBs, SMDBs, and electrical equipment connections specific to fit-out requirements. Review and approve ELV systems design and installation, including structured cabling, CCTV, access control, public address, and other building systems integrated into the fit-out scope. Supervise coordination of electrical requirements with ride vendors, theming contractors, AV specialists, and other specialist suppliers to ensure seamless fit-out integration. Conduct technical oversight of electrical load requirements, equipment interfaces, cable routing, containment, and power supply provisions within fit-out environments. Identify and resolve design gaps, technical discrepancies, constructability issues, and coordination conflicts during the fit-out phase. Supervise interdisciplinary coordination with architectural, interior design, mechanical, FLS, and other disciplines to ensure cohesive fit-out delivery. Ensure all electrical work complies with Saudi Building Code, applicable IEC/NFPA standards, and project-specific requirements throughout the fit-out supervision process. Qualifications and Experience A minimum of 12 years of experience in electrical engineering, with a focus on fit-out projects. Demonstrated ability to supervise complex electrical installation works and ensure compliance with design and specifications. Proficiency in reviewing technical documentation such as shop drawings, material submittals, and calculations. Strong understanding of LV and ELV systems design and installation. Knowledge of Saudi Building Code, IEC/NFPA standards, and project-specific electrical requirements. Work Environment and Culture AECOM fosters a global team environment that supports professional growth and career ambitions. Employees work on projects that impact local communities and global infrastructure. The company provides resources, training, and development programs to enhance technical expertise and leadership skills. AECOM is an Equal Opportunity Employer, committed to a workplace built on respect, collaboration, and community. Application Process As a condition of employment, all newly hired employees are required to attend an in-person Day 1 onboarding at an AECOM office location. AECOM is committed to maintaining a secure and trustworthy recruitment process.

69802af511f12908.description: About the Role Spott HR is seeking an Executive Administrative Assistant for Business Development to join Eezee Middle East - KSA, a global Odoo Gold Partner based in Jeddah. This full-time role supports the sales department, which is central to the company's growth. This position is open to recent graduates with 0-1 years of experience, offering an opportunity to begin a career in a technology-driven environment within Jeddah, Makkah, Saudi Arabia. Role Overview The Executive Administrative Assistant for Business Development will serve as a key coordinator and support system for the Business Development team. This role ensures seamless operations and effective communication, directly impacting sales success and client relationships by providing essential organizational support. Key Responsibilities Provide comprehensive administrative support, including managing calendars, scheduling meetings, and arranging travel for sales executives. Prepare, format, and proofread important documents such as sales proposals, presentations, and contracts. Act as a primary point of contact, handling emails and phone calls with professionalism and efficiency. Maintain and update the client database and sales pipeline within the Odoo CRM system. Assist in the coordination of sales events, meetings, and conferences. Conduct basic market research to help identify potential leads and opportunities. Qualifications and Requirements A Bachelor's degree in Business Administration, Marketing, or a related field is required. Complete fluency in English (both written and verbal) is mandatory. Excellent organizational and time-management skills with a keen eye for detail. Strong interpersonal and communication skills, with a confident and friendly demeanor. A proactive, problem-solving mindset and a strong willingness to learn new skills. Proficiency with the Microsoft Office Suite (Word, Excel, PowerPoint). No prior professional experience is required; recent graduates are encouraged to apply. Work Environment This role is based in Jeddah, Makkah, Saudi Arabia, and operates within a fast-paced, technology-driven environment. The position is full-time, supporting a dynamic sales team focused on providing customized ERP solutions. Application Process Candidates who meet the stated requirements are encouraged to apply. Salary information will be disclosed during the interview process.

69a76564bd01e451.description: About the Role Canonical is seeking a Director Talent Analytics to join the Talent Science team in Riyadh, Saudi Arabia. This full-time role involves leading a team focused on talent analytics and business intelligence to support hiring decisions. The Director will report directly to the Global Head of Talent Science and contribute to the strategic objectives of the team. Role Context and Team Focus The Talent Science team at Canonical ensures an objective, scientifically rigorous, and efficient process for selecting new colleagues. The team utilizes a data-centric approach to analyze hiring data, generate talent analytics, and provide business intelligence. This work supports evidence-based decision-making in hiring and integrates behavioral science into the selection process. The Director will work closely with the Hiring Leadership team to ensure effective hiring practices and the selection of world-class talent. Key Responsibilities Lead a team to achieve strategic objectives, with a focus on product design and roadmap implementation. Analyze hiring data to connect performance outcomes with selection methods, ensuring the identification and progression of talent. Design professional processes and frameworks to facilitate efficient delivery of the team's agenda. Coach and mentor team members to develop analytical capabilities and thought leadership, including creating training materials and documentation. Represent the team in the absence of the Global Head, acting as an adviser and leader. Collaborate with company leaders to understand and communicate the vision for talent at Canonical. Qualifications and Experience Exceptional academic record from high school and university, with an undergraduate degree in a people-based subject. 7+ years of experience in a Talent function, with knowledge of recruitment, selection, and analytics for decision-making. Proven analytical ability to dissect and analyze data using SQL, or proficiency in Python, R, SPSS, or advanced spreadsheet functions with a willingness to learn SQL. Exposure to Business Intelligence (BI) tools, with Superset being the platform used. Demonstrated ability to lead and guide others to deliver results, including project management and coaching for roadmap execution. Proficiency in written and spoken English, with strong presentation skills for senior audiences. Personal motivation aligned with the company's mission. Ability to travel internationally 2-4 times per year for company events, each up to two weeks long. Company Values Canonical values precision, reliability, accessibility, and adroitness. Candidates are expected to demonstrate these qualities in their work and interactions. About Canonical Canonical is a technology firm focused on open source, known for its Ubuntu platform. Ubuntu is utilized in enterprise initiatives such as public cloud, data science, AI, engineering innovation, and IoT. The company serves leading public cloud and silicon providers, as well as industry leaders across various sectors. Founded in 2024, Canonical operates with a distributed collaboration model, with most colleagues working remotely. The company emphasizes high expectations and excellence among its team members.

69901499f7957d0d.description: About SSCL Saudi Service Company Limited (SSCL) is a leading service provider in the Kingdom of Saudi Arabia. The company specializes in maintenance operations, facility management, and technical support services. SSCL is committed to delivering reliable, high-quality, and cost-effective solutions that ensure the smooth and efficient operation of client facilities across the healthcare, industrial, and commercial sectors. The Role SSCL is seeking a Business Development Specialist to join its team in Jeddah, Makkah, Saudi Arabia. This full-time role focuses on identifying and pursuing new business opportunities within the facility management and support services sectors, contributing to the company's long-term growth and market presence. Key Responsibilities Identify and pursue new business opportunities within the facility management and support services sectors. Conduct market research and analysis to assess client needs, market trends, and competitive positioning. Develop and maintain relationships with key clients, partners, and stakeholders to support long-term business growth. Prepare and support bid proposals, tenders, and presentations, ensuring accuracy, compliance, and competitiveness. Collaborate with operations, finance, and procurement teams to align technical and financial proposals with client requirements. Participate in contract negotiations and ensure adherence to company policies and client expectations. Represent the organization at meetings, exhibitions, and industry events to enhance brand visibility and networking reach. Monitor sales pipelines and business development metrics, providing regular reports and forecasts to management. Support the development and implementation of marketing and sales strategies to achieve revenue targets. Qualifications and Experience A minimum of 5 to 10 years of relevant experience in business development, preferably within the facility management or support services sectors. Demonstrated ability to identify and secure new business opportunities. Strong understanding of market dynamics and competitive landscapes. Location and Work Type This is a full-time position based in Jeddah, Makkah, Saudi Arabia. The role requires active engagement in market activities and client interactions within the region. Application Process Interested candidates are invited to apply. Salary details will be discussed during the interview process.

697599308540b518.description: About Camco CAMCO – Capital Metro Company is a Saudi-French joint venture between RATP Dev and SAPTCO. The company is responsible for the operation and maintenance of Riyadh Metro’s Blue and Red Lines. With over 3,000 employees, Camco plays a key role in operating one of the world’s largest fully automated metro networks, delivering safe, reliable, and efficient metro services across Riyadh. The Role: COM & SCADA Technician The COM & SCADA Technician is responsible for executing preventive and corrective maintenance on COM & SCADA equipment. This role requires adherence to relevant regulations, industry best practices, and international benchmarks. The technician will analyze disruptions, implement preventive measures in collaboration with supervisors and external providers, and perform inspections and troubleshooting. Key Responsibilities Execute preventive and corrective maintenance, including repairs of systems, following instructions from superior personnel. Read repair manuals and implement safe work methodologies. Conduct tasks according to work schedules and periodic inspection plans (daily, weekly, monthly, yearly). Prepare tools and materials required for maintenance activities. Prepare failure documentation and submit it to superiors through the CMMS. Monitor commissioning, testing, and trial operation activities of COM & SCADA equipment, reporting recurring defects and disruptions to the Shift Supervisor/Engineer. Monitor and maintain COM & SCADA interface and integration with other disciplines. Operate special tools and measuring devices necessary for maintenance and repair tasks. Perform maintenance activities requiring work at height, on track, stations, and depots, ensuring safety-critical communication protocols and safety rules are followed. Undertake other related tasks assigned by superiors. Required Qualifications and Experience Vocational training in Electronics/Communications Systems. 690d9687c0948552.description: نبذة عن الدور تبحث شركة مرسى الضيافة التجارية عن محاسب تكاليف للانضمام إلى فريقها في المنطقة الشرقية، بمدينة المبرز. يركز هذا الدور على تخطيط ودراسة وتحليل عناصر حسابات التكلفة، بالإضافة إلى إعداد التقارير والوثائق المتعلقة بمحاسبة التكاليف. المهام والمسؤوليات الرئيسية تخطيط ودراسة الأساليب المستخدمة في حساب التكلفة وتحديد عناصر التكلفة المباشرة وغير المباشرة. تحليل عناصر التكلفة المباشرة وغير المباشرة بشكل دوري، وتحديد معدل التكلفة المعيارية، وتحديد الانحرافات ومساهمة كل منها في زيادة أو تقليل التكلفة. إعداد التقارير الدورية المتعلقة بالتكاليف وطرق التسعير، وتقديم التوصيات للإدارة. تطوير أساليب وإجراءات حساب التكاليف ومواكبة التطورات العلمية والتقنية في مجال المحاسبة. إعداد الوثائق والتقارير المتخصصة المتعلقة بحساب التكاليف، وعرضها وحفظها في قاعدة البيانات المخصصة وفقاً للسياسات والإجراءات المعتمدة. المؤهلات والخبرة خبرة تتراوح من 0 إلى 1 سنة في مجال محاسبة التكاليف أو مجال ذي صلة. القدرة على تخطيط ودراسة وتحليل عناصر حسابات التكلفة. مهارات جيدة في إعداد التقارير والوثائق المالية. نوع الوظيفة هذه الوظيفة بدوام كامل. موقع العمل يقع مقر العمل في مدينة المبرز، المنطقة الشرقية. معلومات إضافية الراتب سيتم تحديده بناءً على الخبرة والمؤهلات بعد المقابلة.

69ffe10cc2abd582.description: نبذة عن الدور يقدم مصرف الراجحي فرصة وظيفية لاستشاري مبيعات للانضمام إلى فريقه في المنطقة الشرقية بالمملكة العربية السعودية. يشمل هذا الدور، الذي يتطلب خبرة تتراوح بين 0-1 سنة، العمل بدوام كامل في مدن مثل الدمام، الخبر، الظهران، الجبيل، الأحساء، القطيف، بقيق، راس تنورة، صفوى، الجش، عنك، دارين، العمران، المبرز، والجفر. يركز الدور على تقديم المنتجات والخدمات المصرفية للعملاء بمستوى عالٍ من الجودة والاحترافية. المهام والمسؤوليات الرئيسية يتولى استشاري المبيعات مجموعة من المهام الأساسية التي تضمن سير العمليات المصرفية بسلاسة وفعالية، مع التركيز على خدمة العملاء وتلبية احتياجاتهم. تشمل هذه المهام ما يلي: استقبال طلبات بيع المنتجات المصرفية ومتابعة إدخالها وتنفيذها على الأنظمة المخصصة. مساعدة العملاء في فتح الحسابات، استيفاء المستندات المطلوبة، إدخال البيانات والتوقيعات في النظام، وطلب تعميد مدير العمليات. ترحيل العقود والحسابات عبر البريد إلى مركز المعلومات وعلى نظام إدارة المستندات (DMS). استقبال العملاء في الفرع وتقديم الخدمة المطلوبة، مع توجيههم لإتمام معاملاتهم بشكل صحيح. مساعدة العملاء في تعبئة النماذج اللازمة وتوجيههم لاستخدام أجهزة الصراف الآلي والقنوات الإلكترونية. الاستجابة السريعة لمشاكل العملاء وتلبية طلباتهم وفقاً للإجراءات المعتمدة، والمتابعة مع مراقب الفرع لحل المشكلات. استلام طلبات بطاقات الصراف الآلي، إدخالها في النظام، طباعة البطاقات الفورية، وتسليم البطاقات المجددة. استقبال طلبات تحديث البيانات، قفل الحسابات، وتعديل بيانات الحسابات وتسليمها لمدير العمليات. التعامل مع العملاء الموكلين، استكمال بيانات نماذج التوكيل، مطابقة التوقيعات، وإدخالها في النظام. استيفاء الأوامر المستديمة للعملاء، إنشاء وتنشيط العضويات، وتحويلها لمدير العمليات لاستكمال التنفيذ. التعامل مع طلبات تغيير التوقيع وتحريك الحسابات. إدخال المطالبات المتعلقة بالصراف الآلي ونقاط البيع في نظام مطالبات بطاقات الصراف الآلي. تحويل مشاكل العملاء إلى مدير العمليات للعمل على حلها. الاستعلام عن البطاقات الائتمانية وبطاقات الصراف الآلي المسحوبة في الفرع وتوجيه العملاء لاستلامها. تزويد العملاء بمنشورات المنتجات المصرفية. رفع بلاغات الاشتباه في غسل الأموال وحالات الاحتيال، والإبلاغ عن أي حالات مخالفة للأنظمة والتعليمات. المؤهلات والخبرات يتطلب هذا الدور مرشحين يمتلكون المهارات الأساسية لخدمة العملاء والتعامل مع العمليات المصرفية. يجب أن تتوافر في المتقدمين المؤهلات التالية: خبرة عملية تتراوح بين 0 إلى 1 سنة في مجال ذي صلة. القدرة على التعامل مع أنظمة إدخال البيانات المصرفية. مهارات تواصل ممتازة لتقديم خدمة عملاء احترافية. الالتزام بالدقة والاحترافية في إنجاز المهام. بيئة العمل يُعد هذا الدور وظيفة بدوام كامل ضمن فريق مصرف الراجحي في المنطقة الشرقية، مما يوفر بيئة عمل داعمة ومحفزة لتطوير المهارات المصرفية وخدمة العملاء. التقديم ندعو المهتمين الذين يستوفون المتطلبات المذكورة أعلاه للتقدم لهذه الفرصة في مصرف الراجحي.

694b5356e2dfa0ce.description: About the Role Amazon is seeking an Assistant Category Manager for Amazon Now to join the MENA Grocery team (UFG) in Riyadh, Saudi Arabia. 6948ea2617d2c215.description: نبذة عن الدور تبحث شركة المباني السريعة للمقاولات عن مهندس مدني للانضمام إلى فريقها في حائل. يتولى شاغل الوظيفة مسؤولية دراسة المواقع الإنشائية، وإعداد التصاميم والمخططات، والإشراف على تنفيذ المشاريع لضمان مطابقتها للمواصفات والمعايير الهندسية. المهام والمسؤوليات الرئيسية دراسة طبوغرافية وجيولوجية الموقع الإنشائي، بالإضافة إلى تحليل نتائج اختبار فحص التربة. دراسة المتطلبات والمخططات المعمارية للمشروع بدقة. تحديد أعماق التأسيس اللازمة للمشروع وإجراء تحليل إنشائي متكامل لعناصره. إعداد تصاميم المشروع ومتابعة إعداد المخططات الإنشائية وتدقيقها. تدقيق جداول الكميات والمواصفات الخاصة بالمواد الإنشائية. الإشراف المباشر على تنفيذ المشروع ومطابقة جميع الأعمال للمواصفات الفنية. تطوير أساليب وإجراءات العمل ومواكبة التطورات التقنية في مجال الهندسة المدنية. إعداد الوثائق والتقارير المتخصصة بنتائج الأعمال والمشروعات الهندسية، وتوضيح نسبة تقدمها، وحفظها في قاعدة البيانات المعتمدة. المؤهلات والخبرات المطلوبة خبرة عملية تتراوح بين 2 إلى 5 سنوات في مجال الهندسة المدنية. القدرة على دراسة وتحليل المواقع الإنشائية. مهارات عالية في إعداد التصاميم الإنشائية والمخططات. القدرة على الإشراف على تنفيذ المشاريع وضمان الجودة. بيئة العمل هذه الوظيفة بدوام كامل في مدينة حائل، وتتطلب التزاماً بالإشراف الميداني والمكتبي لضمان سير المشاريع وفقاً للمعايير المحددة. التقديم للمهتمين بالانضمام إلى فريق عمل شركة المباني السريعة للمقاولات، يرجى تقديم طلبات التوظيف. سيتم التواصل مع المرشحين المؤهلين لتحديد الخطوات التالية.

69b5a92795b72306.description: نبذة عن الدور تبحث مختبر الدقة العالية الطبي عن فني مختبر طبي للانضمام إلى فريقها في المدينة المنورة. يهدف هذا الدور بدوام كامل إلى دعم العمليات المخبرية من خلال إجراء الفحوصات والتحاليل الدقيقة للعينات، مع ضمان جودة النتائج والالتزام بالمعايير المهنية. يتطلب الدور خبرة تتراوح من 0 إلى سنة واحدة. المهام والمسؤوليات الرئيسية تفقد وتشغيل وصيانة معدات حفظ وفحص العينات، وضبطها وفقاً لنوع الفحص المطلوب ومراقبة أدائها. دراسة طلبات الأطباء لتحديد الفحوصات المطلوبة، وسحب عينات الدم، واستلام عينات البول والبراز. تدوين بيانات المرضى على العينات وحفظها وفقاً لأسس الحفظ الصحيحة لضمان سلامتها ودقتها. تحضير العينات للفحص والزراعة، واختيار مواد الفحص بالكميات والمواصفات المطلوبة. إجراء الفحوصات المختلفة والتحاليل الكيميائية، الفيزيائية، والمجهرية على العينات. استخراج النتائج وتوثيقها بدقة، وإتلاف العينات بعد إجراء الفحوصات مع توثيق إجراءات الإتلاف. إعداد وتقديم تقارير العمل الدورية وتوثيقها وحفظها بشكل منظم. المؤهلات والخبرات خبرة عملية تتراوح من 0 إلى سنة واحدة في مجال المختبرات الطبية. القدرة على التعامل مع المعدات المخبرية المختلفة وتشغيلها وصيانتها. معرفة جيدة بأسس حفظ العينات وإجراءات السلامة المخبرية. بيئة العمل يعمل فني المختبر الطبي ضمن فريق مختبر الدقة العالية الطبي في المدينة المنورة. الوظيفة بدوام كامل وتتطلب الالتزام بالمعايير المهنية العالية في بيئة عمل داعمة ومجهزة. معلومات إضافية الراتب لهذه الوظيفة غير معلن وسيتم تحديده بناءً على المؤهلات والخبرة خلال عملية التوظيف.

69f1f00ddb6028a5.description: نبذة عن الدور تبحث شركة المياه الخليجية للمقاولات عن مهندس ميكانيكي للانضمام إلى فريقها في الدمام، المنطقة الشرقية. يركز هذا الدور على إعداد التصاميم والمخططات الهندسية، بالإضافة إلى تطوير برامج التشغيل والصيانة للمعدات الميكانيكية في المشاريع الصناعية. المهام والمسؤوليات الرئيسية إعداد التصاميم والمخططات التفصيلية لمشاريع الهندسة الميكانيكية، بما في ذلك المولدات، التوربينات، وحدات التكييف، المراجل، وشبكات توزيع أنظمة التدفئة والتكييف والتبريد. تطوير خطط وبرامج تجميع وتركيب التجهيزات الميكانيكية للمشاريع الصناعية، وتحديد أنظمة الضبط والتحكم اللازمة. إعداد برامج تشغيل المعدات وبرامج الصيانة الوقائية بناءً على تعليمات الشركات المصنعة، ومتابعة تنفيذ هذه الإجراءات. المساهمة في تطوير أساليب وإجراءات العمل ومواكبة أحدث التطورات التقنية في المجال. إعداد الوثائق والتقارير المتخصصة المتعلقة بالأعمال والمشاريع الهندسية، وتوضيح نسب التقدم، وحفظها في قاعدة البيانات المخصصة وفقاً للسياسات والإجراءات المعتمدة. المؤهلات والخبرات المطلوبة خبرة تتراوح من 0 إلى 1 سنة في مجال الهندسة الميكانيكية. القدرة على إعداد التصاميم والمخططات الهندسية بدقة. معرفة ببرامج تشغيل المعدات الصناعية وبرامج الصيانة الوقائية. بيئة العمل هذه الوظيفة بدوام كامل وتقع في مدينة الدمام بالمنطقة الشرقية. سيعمل المهندس الميكانيكي ضمن فريق متخصص في مشاريع المقاولات المتعلقة بالمياه. معلومات إضافية الراتب لهذه الوظيفة سيتم تحديده بناءً على المؤهلات والخبرة، وسيتم مناقشته خلال عملية التوظيف. التقديم للمهتمين بالانضمام إلى شركة المياه الخليجية للمقاولات، يرجى تقديم طلباتكم عبر القنوات المتاحة.

698f2f83a8abea72.description: About SYSTRA SYSTRA is a global engineering and consultancy group specializing in public transport and sustainable mobility. With over 10,300 employees, SYSTRA focuses on designing safe and sustainable transport solutions to enhance social inclusion and facilitate access to employment, education, and leisure worldwide. For 65 years, the Group has supported cities and regions in developing, improving, and modernizing their infrastructure and transport systems across all project life cycles, from design to testing, deployment, and maintenance. Operating in over 80 countries, SYSTRA generates 74% of its turnover internationally and supports clients in their digital, ecological, and energy transitions. The Role: Lead Operation and Maintenance (O&M) Metro/Rail Project SYSTRA is seeking a Lead Operation and Maintenance (O&M) professional to join our team in Riyadh, Saudi Arabia. This full-time role involves acting as an expert in operation and maintenance for Automatic Metro Systems within a significant Metro project. The successful candidate will be responsible for overseeing the operability and maintainability of the Transportation system, including its sub-systems and equipment, ensuring compliance with contractual requirements throughout all project phases. The objective is to achieve the highest international standards for railway systems. Key Responsibilities Establish and deliver documentation review reports in a timely manner, adhering to project schedules and quality policies. Report on compliance and deviations during relevant design progress meetings. Maintain privacy in communications with various stakeholders. Organize workshops and meetings with contractors to identify gaps, facilitate solution development, and ensure timely submissions. Report to the Package Manager, System Manager, and Design Manager on pending issues and potential non-compliance. Issue weekly progress reports. Participate in Factory Acceptance Tests (FAT) and on-site tests, both locally and internationally. Act as an Operation and Maintenance expert on behalf of the Engineer to the Employer, as requested. Provide expert advice within the Engineer's team regarding the operability and maintainability of various sub-systems (E&M, Signaling, Track, Civil work, Rolling stock, Communication, External stakeholders). Implement necessary reporting to generate relevant project information. Provide constraints to sub-systems. Communicate inputs clearly and in a controlled manner to relevant parties. Manage design changes and ensure they are communicated and adequately addressed by the Contractor. Ensure design consistency across sub-systems and verify compliance with allocated requirements. Check traceability evidence between requirement definitions and design compliance. Define appropriate actions and prepare technical requests for follow-up. Translate operating requirements into specific criteria for sub-system management. Manage train operation during construction activities. Participate in Factory Acceptance Tests (FAT) and On-Site Tests (OST). Qualifications and Experience A minimum of 10 years of experience in operation and maintenance, specifically within Automatic Metro Systems or similar rail projects. Demonstrated expertise in the operability and maintainability of transportation systems and their sub-systems. Proven ability to ensure compliance with contractual requirements across various project phases. Strong understanding of international standards for railway systems. Work Location This full-time position is based in Riyadh, Saudi Arabia.

Key Responsibilities Research client accounts and establish contact to agree on suitable payment plans, developing collection schedules and methods. Follow up with clients to collect receivables according to communicated deadlines, ensuring payments are processed promptly. Monitor accounts to identify overdue payments and debts, investigate historical data, and initiate legal actions when necessary, in coordination with the direct manager.
